message.content:
I replaced the deep copies of the field vectors with moves from the source, eliminating per-field allocations and vector element copies. This is faster because the decoder discards the copied-from temporaries immediately after construction.

```include
#include <utility>
```

```cpp
Mesg::Mesg(const Mesg &mesg)
    : profile(mesg.profile)
    , localNum(mesg.localNum)
    , fields(std::move(const_cast<Mesg&>(mesg).fields))
    , devFields(std::move(const_cast<Mesg&>(mesg).devFields))
{
}
```
